title: Premier Football UK news
context: Warm contact. David Jervis, founder of Premier Football UK (UK football trials for players aged 7 to 21 in front of professional club staff, since 2009), was interviewed on 3 Nov 2026: /parent-guides/david-jervis-football-trials-interview. He asked us to keep the three links to his site in the interview (done) and said they will link to the interview from their news page. His words are also quoted in ExpertQA boxes on football-scholarships-uk, late-developers-in-football and what-happens-at-academy-trials.
fit_note: Their families' first questions are scholarships, late development and trial preparation, which our three guides answer as neutral explainers; two of them quote David and one tells his Isaac Lee story.
angle: Already promised: a news post linking the interview. Ask (Graham's email, 3 Nov) for links from that post or their site to /academy-pathway/football-scholarships-uk (first choice), /football-development/late-developers-in-football and /academy-trials/what-happens-at-academy-trials, plus reposts of the three Instagram carousels with @premier_football_uk_trials as collaborator. Do not ask for links to football-trials-near-me, football-academy-trials-uk or how-to-get-scouted: same 'football trials' searches as their business, and those pages warn about paid showcases. Link check: look for any of the four URLs (interview plus the three guides) on premierfootballuk.com.
